notes: These are slicer estimates, not physical weighing measurements. A sweeping/scale animation is illustrative.
Displayed total = model-channel main mass + support/interface main mass. Model-channel mass includes configured brim; purge and prime tower are excluded.
Support share (%) = 100 × support_g / total_body_support_g. It is not the support share of all printer-consumed filament.

White PLA slot 1 is the model channel; blue PLA slot 3 is support and support interface. Flush into model, infill, and support was disabled; prime towers were retained but excluded from these metrics.
Chair TRELLIS.2, chair SAS, and penguin SAS contain a small brim in the white model channel; no separate brim mass is reported in the small result metadata.
Christmas tree SAS uses less support mass than TRELLIS.2 but a higher support percentage because its total model-plus-support mass is lower.
The two poodle models retain different original print orientations; these examples are qualitative, not a matched-pose benchmark.
No invalid penguin TRELLIS.2 example is included.

field_definitions.body_g: Slicer main model-channel mass (white slot 1), including brim where configured; not strictly cleaned-object mass
field_definitions.support_g: Slicer main support plus support-interface mass (blue slot 3)
field_definitions.has_brim: Brim feature found in both result feature_type_times and existing G-code role audit
